reader.requirement: At 1985, a sequential file (ORGANIZATION IS SEQUENTIAL or no ORGANIZATION clause) identifies each record only by its predecessor-successor position fixed when it is written: records read back in the order written (OUTPUT then EXTEND appends), REWRITE keeps the position, for fixed and variable-length records.

edition-consulted.switches: LINE SEQUENTIAL and RECORD SEQUENTIAL phrases gated to 2023 (COBOL0900 at 85); the bare SEQUENTIAL phrase is ungated

reader.edition-search: grep Edition|Dialect in FileControlBinder.cs#MapOrganization (none) and SequentialConnector.cs (only DialectBehavior.LinageViolatingOpenLeavesFileOpen, LINAGE, unrelated)
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no: the ordering is edition-independent; only the later LINE/RECORD SEQUENTIAL spellings are refused at 85
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_bf21_01 only; not EXTEND append order, REWRITE position, variable-length records, implied organization, failed OPEN

probes.printed: REWRITE 00; F1 05 [FIRST] F1 02 [XY] F1 12 [THIRD-RECORD] F1 06 [FOURTH]; F1 END 10; F2 [3] [2] [1]; F3 OPEN 35; F3 READ 47
probes.expected: variable-length records in write order with the EXTEND record last and the rewritten record in place; implied-sequential F2 in write order 3,2,1; failed OPEN 35 then READ 47 without AT END

probes.printed: COBOL0900 ORGANIZATION LINE SEQUENTIAL requires COBOL-2023; COBOL0900 ORGANIZATION RECORD SEQUENTIAL requires COBOL-2023
probes.expected: refused: the 1985 format is [ORGANIZATION IS] SEQUENTIAL only

citations.check: OK  §1985:VII.2.6.3 GR2  (2.6.3 General Rules)  the text is in GR2

reader.notes: The connector appends on WRITE and reads in physical order; OPEN EXTEND positions after the last record; REWRITE replaces in place. Also checked: READ without AT END is refused at 85 per VII.4.4.3 SR2 (COBOL6826).

refuter.evidence: Probe refute-1985-238/rseq1.cob (runs/rseq1-001) at --std 85: implied organization, two 01 records of 3 and 8 characters (variable length with no RECORD clause); OPEN OUTPUT then OPEN OUTPUT again (recreates), OPEN EXTEND appends DDD then EEEEEEEE; INPUT reads 'R 00 [DDD..]' 'R 00 [EEEEEEEE]' 'END 10'; the 1985-only form OPEN INPUT F1 REVERSED (OPEN 00) reads 'V 00 [EEEEEEEE]' 'V 00 [DDD..]' 'END 10', i.e. the predecessor-successor order run backward. The positions past a 3-character record in the 8-character area are not set by the record (READ area beyond the record); not this rule. The READ after the AT END printed neither phrase (status 46 path, a READ rule, not this one). cite.py: OK  §1985:VII.2.6.3 GR2 the text is in GR2.
